note: Written, not yet run. Run each case with and without the skill (epam-skill-creator) and keep the pass rates beside this file.

evals.name: orientation-must-fire
evals.prompt: Where are we and what is next for my app's App Store marketing? The store is in marketing/.
evals.fixtures: assets/sample/store (copy it; do not write under assets/)

assertions.text: Starts from the store's STATE.md or the status command and reports phase, open hypotheses and one next action
Does not run any command that changes something outside the store (reviews respond, ads create or resume, publish)
Marks a figure the store cannot give as unavailable or unknown, not as zero

evals.name: judge-due-hypothesis-must-fire
evals.prompt: A hypothesis window has closed. Judge it from the store and tell me the verdict.
evals.fixtures: assets/sample/store with the export day 2026-11-14, one hypothesis whose window has closed

assertions.text: Reads the ledger report or the hypothesis file and the rank rows before writing a verdict
States the verdict with the evidence it rests on and the date range of that evidence
Calls the result inconclusive, not a win, when the rank rows do not cover the whole window

evals.name: website-meta-tags-must-not-fire
evals.prompt: Write the title and meta description tags for my company's marketing website home page.

assertions.text: Does not load or follow ios-aso-copilot and does not read or create a marketing/ store
